layout_and_sections.description: Warm bronze & cream metric strip displaying Google Rating, Experience, Verified Care, and Location landmark.
Short brand story narrative with side-by-side high resolution salon imagery, accent text, and signature salon values.
Categorized interactive tabs for Hair Care, Beauty & Skin, Professional Makeup, and Men's Grooming with realistic descriptions, durations, and key benefits (no invented pricing).
4-part bento grid highlighting Hygiene & Sanitization, Certified Master Stylists, Premium Product Lines, and Tailored Consultation.
Editorial gallery showing real salon ambience (storefront signage, interior aesthetic, spa suite, pedicure setup) with image zoom hover effects and full-screen lightbox modal.
Customer reviews featuring verified Google 4.6★ reviews, client names, ratings, and feedback.
Direct contact card, live status badge, operating hours, quick address copy button, and embedded interactive Google Map with 'Get Directions' CTA.
Large typography brand mark, quick link menu, operating hours summary, Instagram handle @bloomsalon.bm link, and contact details.
Floating WhatsApp icon button on Desktop bottom-right + Fixed dual action bar (Call / WhatsApp) anchored to mobile screen bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive buttons, links, and key items include explicit data-testid attributes for testing.
Do not include any pricing numbers in service lists unless explicitly asked.
Both Call (+91 88491 03859) and WhatsApp links must be active, formatted, and easily reachable.
Mobile layout must include a fixed bottom dual bar with 'Call Salon' and 'WhatsApp Salon' buttons.
Desktop layout must feature a subtle floating WhatsApp icon on the bottom right.
Use raw Tailwind CSS styling with custom fonts loaded from Google Fonts (Cormorant Garamond & Plus Jakarta Sans).
Implement full-screen gallery lightbox modal on gallery thumbnail click.
Maintain strict APCA contrast standards using warm cream (#FAFAFA / #F4F1EA), deep charcoal (#1C1C1C), and muted gold (#C5A059).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Create creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use purple gradients or heavy dark-only themes. Stick to luxury warm cream, charcoal, and muted gold.
Ensure all buttons have hover, active, and focus styles with data-testid attributes.
All navigation links must be clear and smoothly scroll to their target sections.
Never use generic AI emojis (🤖, 🧠, 💡) for icons; use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
